CBI Books Subhash Chandra in Rs 1,322 Crore LIC Housing Finance Fraud Case

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has filed a case against Essel Group Chairman Subhash Chandra and others for allegedly defrauding LIC Housing Finance Ltd of approximately Rs 1,322 crore. The complaint, filed by LIC, alleges that Chandra and others inflated their net worth to secure loans. One report states the net worth claim at the heart of the complaint was Rs 59,113 crore, while another mentioned nearly Rs 1,000 crore in loans were secured. The Wire reported that LIC filed a complaint with the CBI alleging Subhash Chandra falsely inflated his net worth to take loans.
